minor.issue: No auth check — anyone with UUID can download PDF (carried over from iteration 1).
Rate-limit key uses request.client.host (LB IP) — potential shared-lockout risk (carried over).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: PDF endpoints for both inspections and reports remain public (no Depends(get_current_user)); the `auth` query param is accepted but never validated. Should verify token before streaming.

std_filename() strips only hyphens from date — if inspection_date is empty/missing, filename becomes e.g. 'SIR--<job>-...' with a double-dash. Consider defaulting to 'unknown' or today's date if missing.

update_report() in server.py does not run any completeness gating for status='submitted' (unlike update_inspection which validates 100% checklist). If ECR business rules require certain fields to be non-empty at submit, that gating should be moved server-side (currently only client toast).

ReportWorkflow.canSet allows 'supervisor'/'head_maintenance' to click 'Tandai Checked' when status==='approved'. Frontend will let them click but backend will 403 for supervisor. UX-wise consider hiding the Checked button entirely when status='approved' AND role != head_maintenance/admin.

NewHOR.jsx submit(): payload spread `{ ...payload, status }` overwrites status; combined with `payload.status` from previous ...f leaves an intermediate — cosmetic but works; consider explicitly setting status once.
Reports don't have an `inspection_date` — filename uses `report_date`. Confirm date field naming is consistent (spec said YYYYMMDD from the report/inspection date — matches).
server.py `update_report` accepts arbitrary payload dict — no Pydantic validation; consider a Pydantic ReportInput model to guard against malformed data.
seed_data_creation: Test data prefixed TEST-IT3-* / TEST_ECR_* / TEST_HOR_* is created + auto-deleted during pytest. Frontend Playwright reports were also created + deleted by admin.
